title: Acherim (Others)
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Horayot 13a (compare [Horayot 13b](https://www.sefaria.org/Horayot.13b.17)), it is told that because of the dispute, since Rabbi Meir and Rabbi Natan wanted to remove Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel from his patriarchate, he penalized Rabbi Meir to be called by the name "Acherim" (Others). But this is not always so, for we find in [Sotah 12a](https://www.sefaria.org/Sotah.12a.17) a dispute of "Acherim" with Rabbi Meir; and in Sefer Keritut, Yemot Olam, he wrote that when Rabbi Meir would state a halakha in the name of his teacher Elisha-Acher, they then called him by the name "Acherim."

And this name is mentioned in Berakhot 29a, [Shabbat 5a](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.5a.3), [Eruvin 58b:3](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.58b.3), [Sukkah 7b:18](https://www.sefaria.org/Sukkah.7b.18), [Sukkah 54b:9-10](https://www.sefaria.org/Sukkah.54b.9-10), [Megillah 31b:2](https://www.sefaria.org/Megillah.31b.2), [Chagigah 4a:9](https://www.sefaria.org/Chagigah.4a.9), [Yevamot 48b:16](https://www.sefaria.org/Yevamot.48b.16), [Nedarim 20a:12](https://www.sefaria.org/Nedarim.20a.12), [Sotah 46b:1](https://www.sefaria.org/Sotah.46b.1), [Gittin 27b:10](https://www.sefaria.org/Gittin.27b.10), [Bava Batra 96b:3](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.96b.3), [Bava Batra 107a:8](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.107a.8), [Sanhedrin 63a:16](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.63a.16), [Shevuot 35b:7](https://www.sefaria.org/Shevuot.35b.7), [Avodah Zarah 30b:8-9](https://www.sefaria.org/Avodah_Zarah.30b.8-9), [Horayot 9a:2](https://www.sefaria.org/Horayot.9a.2), [Zevachim 29a](https://www.sefaria.org/Zevachim.29a.12), [Zevachim 43b:9](https://www.sefaria.org/Zevachim.43b.9), [Zevachim 94a:9](https://www.sefaria.org/Zevachim.94a.9), [Menachot 16b:16](https://www.sefaria.org/Menachot.16b.16), [Menachot 37a:4](https://www.sefaria.org/Menachot.37a.4), [Chullin 65a:5](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.65a.5), [Chullin 119a:6](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.119a.6), [Keritot 11a:12](https://www.sefaria.org/Keritot.11a.12).[^2][^3]

notes.text: Hyman supplies Horayot 13a; the consulted passage is 13b. Sotah 12a names both Rabbi Meir and Acherim. His Sefer Keritut, Yemot Olam explanation is retained as his report; that exact work passage was not independently inspected. This does not identify every Acherim occurrence with Meir.

Horayot records the sanction and assigns ‘Others’ to Rabbi Meir and ‘Some Say’ to Rabbi Natan in that episode. Sotah reports Rabbi Meir and ‘Others’ separately. Heilprin’s entry supplies a parallel citation list. The exact wording of Sefer Keritut cited by Hyman remains uncollated. See [Heilprin’s parallel notice](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=380&lang=en).

[Horayot 13b:17](https://www.sefaria.org/Horayot.13b.17) applies “Acherim” to Rabbi Meir and “Some say” to Rabbi Natan in that episode. The prayer in danger attributed to Acherim appears at [Berakhot 29b:14-15](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.29b.14-15). Hyman gives Berakhot 29a. The other linked occurrences use the designation “Acherim” without naming Rabbi Meir.
